name: dsh-marker-extension
description: Firefox/Zen MV3 extension that sends page annotations to a DeepSeek Harness host plugin over the bridge websocket (ws:// or wss://, as advertised by the host).
//readme: Loaded straight from this folder as a temporary add-on: about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox -> Load Temporary Add-on -> manifest.json. There is no build step, no bundler, no TypeScript, and no dependency: manifest.json, the classic background/content scripts, and the popup are shipped exactly as written.
//dependencies: Intentionally empty. The workspace has no registry access and the extension must stay auditable, so nothing here is installed; scripts below only shell out to `npx web-ext` on a machine that already has it.
//protocol: src/shared/protocol.js is ESM and only used by tooling; the browser loads the generated classic copy src/shared/protocol.global.js. Never edit either copy by hand - regenerate both with `pnpm run sync-protocol` in the repository root.

scripts.//lint: Static validation of manifest.json plus the shipped files (web-ext is invoked through npx; it is not a dependency of this package).
scripts.//run: Open a throwaway Firefox profile with this extension loaded and reload it on file changes.
scripts.//build: Build both store targets from this tree (dist/firefox, dist/chromium); the source tree itself is not the artifact. `web-ext build --source-dir ../../dist/firefox` then packages the signed-upload zip.
scripts.//sign: AMO signing uploads dist/firefox; credentials come from addons.mozilla.org/developers/addon/api/key/ and only exist on a maintainer machine or in CI.
